author: Traditionally Moses
authorNote: Jewish and Christian tradition names Moses. Many modern scholars think the five books of the Law were drawn together from several sources over centuries, reaching their final form around the 6th–5th century BC; others defend substantial Mosaic authorship.
date: Traditionally c. 1400s BC; many scholars link it to the 7th century BC
overview: Before he dies, Moses gives a series of speeches to the new generation on the edge of the promised land. He retells their history, repeats God's law, and urges them to love the Lord with all their heart. The book ends with Moses' death.
storyPlace: The end of the five books of the Law. Jesus quotes Deuteronomy more than almost any other book.
